title: Clarify vague kidney-medication question to eGFR31 continuation

interaction.prompt: Evaluate whether the assistant asks for the minimum decision-critical information before applying a label rule.

prior_turns.content: My kidney function isn't great. Can I keep taking my diabetes medicine?
It's metformin ER. My current eGFR is 31.

must_include: Collect medication identity, current eGFR and continuation/initiation state before a rule-specific conclusion.
At final state, recognize eGFR31 is not below the <30 contraindication threshold.
For current use below45, apply benefit-risk reassessment rather than the separate initiation rule.
must_not_claim: Do not call eGFR31 an absolute <30 contraindication.
Do not answer the first vague turn as if eGFR were known.
acceptable_actions: ASK -> UPDATE STATE -> APPLY CONTINUATION RULE
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Uncertain until critical slots are filled; precise after final turn within label scope.

forbidden_claims: initiation and continuation rules are identical

critical_errors: Gives a definitive threshold answer before obtaining eGFR.
Applies the initiation rule to an established user without distinction.
